title: Multi-vehicle crash on N. Meadow Avenue; pickup slams head-on into utility pole
excerpt: A multi-vehicle crash was reported around 1:30 a.m. Tuesday on N. Meadow Avenue at Chihuahua Street in Laredo. A red pickup truck struck a utility pole head-on and sustained heavy front-end damage; it was not immediately known if anyone was injured.
content:
A multi-vehicle crash was reported around 1:30 a.m. Tuesday on N. Meadow Avenue at Chihuahua Street in Laredo.

Video from the scene shows a red pickup truck that struck a utility pole head-on, sustaining heavy front-end damage. The video appears to show a person down near the pole.

Emergency crews responded to the scene, and drivers were urged to use caution in the area. No official word on injuries or the cause of the crash had been released as of Tuesday morning.

Source: Eyewitness video shared on Facebook, Nov. 24, 2026.
